name: codex-auto-pilot
description: Deliver approved plans through a configurable PR stage and optionally auto-start a fresh release task.

interface.shortDescription: Build a verified PR and optionally auto-start its fresh release task
interface.longDescription: Uses one controller, one declared accountable implementation lane, optional bounded helpers, one compact handoff, and an optional ship lane that starts a separate fresh release task after PR readiness. Model and thinking preferences are configurable; task isolation and release safety are fixed.
defaultPrompt: $auto-pilot pr <approved-plan-path>. Use ship instead when I explicitly want Auto Pilot to create a fresh release task immediately after the PR becomes ready.
